captions.say: Ask a computer for zero point one plus zero point two.
It says zero point three, then fifteen zeros, then a four.

captions.text: And in binary, *0.1* is like *one-third* in decimal:
captions.say: And in binary, zero point one is like one third in decimal:
Zero point zero zero zero one one zero zero one one, forever.

captions.text: The computer has to *round it off* after *52 bits,*
captions.say: The computer has to round it off after fifty-two bits,

captions.text: so it stores a number !very slightly off.!
That's why programmers don't compare decimals *with equals,*
and why money is usually stored as *whole cents.*
